Figure 6:Example long-duration gameplay sequences fromGameVerse.
Each row shows temporally continuous frames sampled from a single gameplay clip across diverse game environments, including indoor exploration, natural scenes, urban driving areas, sunset city environments, and nighttime interaction scenarios.
The examples demonstrate the strong temporal continuity, environmental diversity, camera motion consistency, and rich visual dynamics provided by GameVerse.

Figure 8:Qualitative image-to-video generation results of the LTX-2.3 model fine-tuned onGameVerse.
Given a single initial frame together with camera trajectories and structured semantic captions, the model generates long-duration gameplay videos with consistent scene layouts, stable camera motion, and coherent temporal dynamics across diverse environments, including natural exploration, urban interaction, horse riding, and nighttime driving scenarios.

Figure 9:Qualitative image-to-video generation results conditioned on camera trajectories and structured semantic captions.
The blue trajectory overlays visualize the input camera motion signals used for controllable generation.
Given a single initial frame, the LTX-Video-2 model fine-tuned onGameVerseis able to generate temporally coherent long-duration gameplay videos with stable camera-aware motion, consistent scene geometry, and smooth environmental transitions across diverse gameplay scenarios.
